attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The day's line carries «και διήγησις πάνυ ωφέλιμος», and a most profitable narrative, which is the title of the reading and not a second commemoration. The page gives no year and names no emir but the title Ἀμηρᾶς, so no `dates` object. Tenese in Egypt is named; no coordinate is proposed. The corpus holds nobody of this name. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.12.2025 (11. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Миракс.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth and last entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: this book calls him the plain «мученик» where the folder holds `new-martyr`, and the fuller grade is saint.gr’s and is exactly what this entry’s story describes — a Christian who accepted Islam and then repented of it and confessed Christ. Nothing was downgraded on a shorter rank word. `dates` ADDED, and it is the first date of any kind this folder has carried: «Мучен и посечен око 640. године» — tortured and beheaded ABOUT 640. The book says «око», about, and not a year, so the bounds are set as an approximation of five years either side and the display keeps the «c.»; nothing narrower is claimed. saint.gr prints him with no year. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, where the Greek line was a name and the words “and a most profitable narrative”: that he was an Egyptian; that he was misled by a Muslim emir and accepted Islam; and that he then repented, WENT INTO THE MOSQUE WITH A CROSS, declared himself a Christian and called on the Muslims to leave the lie and receive the truth, for which he was tortured and beheaded. NO `locations`: Egypt is a country and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO `related` row: the entry names nobody, the emir included. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 11. децембар ст. ст.: „Мучен и посечен око 640. године.“ — tortured and beheaded about 640. The first date of any kind this folder has carried: saint.gr prints him as «Άγιος Μείραξ και διήγησις πάνυ ωφέλιμος» and gives no year. THE BOOK SAYS «око», ABOUT, AND NOT A YEAR, so the bounds are set as an approximation of five years either side of it, on the reading `hermogenes-of-moscow`'s «c. 1530» already stands on, and the display keeps the «c.» rather than claiming the year flat.
